warp.bot: Use when the merchant wants to email the customer a branded order confirmation or payment reminder for a pending order. List orders first to resolve orderId. Prefer this over drafting a freeform contact message so branding and the pay/order link stay intact. The executing agent is used as the sender. For unpaid pending orders use type payment-reminder; otherwise use confirmation.

inputs.name: Order ID

description.en: Hash ID of the order to notify about

inputs.bot: The order hash ID. List orders first if needed.

inputs.name: Type
inputs.bot: Use confirmation for order confirmation emails. Use payment-reminder only for pending unpaid orders.

description.en: Agent UUID used as the email sender

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.

en: Email a pending order confirmation to the customer
Resend branded order confirmation with invoice
Send a payment reminder for an unpaid pending shop order
de: Gebrandete Bestellbestätigung mit Rechnung erneut senden
Zahlungserinnerung für eine unbezahlte Shop-Bestellung senden

en.question: Who receives the email?
en.answer: The customer contact on the order (not a separate invoice recipient).

en.question: Which agent sends it?
en.answer: The executing agent is used as the sender.

en.question: When do I use payment-reminder?
en.answer: Only for unpaid pending shop orders (not quotes). Use confirmation otherwise.

de.question: Wer erhält die E-Mail?
de.answer: Der Kundenkontakt der Bestellung (nicht ein separater Rechnungsempfänger).

de.question: Welcher Agent sendet?
de.answer: Der ausführende Agent wird als Absender verwendet.

de.question: Wann nutze ich payment-reminder?
de.answer: Nur für unbezahlte ausstehende Shop-Bestellungen (keine Angebote). Sonst confirmation.

warp.bot: Use when the user wants to start a return on a paid order after items were shipped, delivered, or picked up. Pass items as JSON like [{"orderItemId":1,"quantity":1}] using numeric orderItemId from get_order. Optional fulfillmentId links the return to a shipment. On success RETURN_ID and RETURN_STATUS must be set — if empty, treat as failure and inspect the API error. Verify with list_returns or get_order.returns before claiming success.
